description: One operation-failure ledger row, checked against every surface that renders it. The CLI card (dashboard_renderer) and the app card (lib/unavailable-state) each read this file, so a surface that changes what it shows on its own fails here rather than drifting quietly. Scoped to the title and the target because those are the only facts BOTH cards present: the CLI card renders title + target + recency and never the message, which it shows in the worktree detail panel instead. Keep each title under 48 characters and each target under 24 -- the CLI card truncates at those widths, and a longer value would make the assertion turn on the truncation rather than on the fact.
generatedBy: hand-written; there is no capture script for this pair

cases.why: a refusal, the case that started this: it reached neither card until the ledger recorded it
